messages:
alex.k: starting canary rollout v3.4.2 to canary-1 (02:00-04:00 window). pushing 10% traffic. deploy-bot: Deploy triggered for service=inference runtime=v3.4.2 canary=canary-1 by alex.k. CI checks passed. rolling shards 0-3.
maria.s: saw a tiny bump on embed p95 in us-west-2 right after shard 1 came up, ~120ms -> ~210ms. not huge but visible.
jon.p: can you paste the metric query?
maria.s: `sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/embed"}[1m])) by (le)` — p95 from cloudwatch alarm dashboard. snapshot: p95=210ms, p50 stable.
tasha: @alex.k recommend pausing further canaries until we validate warmup. last time a kv-prefill missed and we hit steady-state cold misses.
alex.k: ok pausing rollout. deploy-bot: Rollout paused by alex.k. 10% remains.
deploy-bot: Post-deploy smoke checks: canary-1: health=OK, synthetics=partial_fail (embed_probe: 3/10 fails), error_rate=0.02%, prefill_warmth=low.
maria.s: the synthetic probe that fails is the embed prefix-case, failures look like 503s with `kv-miss` in logs.
jon.p: sharing a small log tail from the replica: ```
[2026-03-21T02:12:01Z] WARN prefix_cache: miss key=conv_12345
[2026-03-21T02:12:01Z] ERROR inference: model-shard-1 failed fast-retry (403)
```
tasha: hmm 403 on retry indicates auth handshake flakiness? but kv-miss + 403 is odd. @srebot can you run a quick kv warmup on canary-1?
srebot: Running warmup task `kv-prefill --target canary-1 --pattern 'conv_*' --parallel 4`. ETA ~45s. Will report results.
maria.s: while warmup runs, FYI p95 trend shows regressions correlate with traffic spike on `/v1/embed?topk=5`.
jon.p: can we try a soft-fallback to smaller batch size for embed route? maybe reduce `max_batch_tokens` from 4096->2048 for canary-1 to see if that reduces tail.
alex.k: we can push a dynamic config change to canary-1 only. agree to try reduced batch. who can flip?
tasha: i can flip it via runtime-config. `runtimectl set canary-1 inference.max_batch_tokens=2048`
tasha: done. config change rolled to canary-1.
srebot: warmup task complete: 2000 keys prefetched, hit_rate improved from 12%->78% on canary-1 prefix cache.
deploy-bot: Synth check re-run in progress (3 probes).
maria.s: re-checking metrics... embed p95 back to ~130ms, synthetics: embed_probe 0/3 fails now. nice.
onboard: (bot) quicknote: alert `embed-p95` suppressed for 10m due to rollout window.
jon.p: ok looks good. do we continue rollout to canary-2?
alex.k: proceed but keep automated rollback at 5min window if embeds regress beyond 150ms p95. deploy-bot: Rollout resumed to canary-2 at 02:17.
tasha: I'll keep an eye, will run additional prefills if needed. file a followup to test broader kv-prefill in staging.
maria.s: create a ticket for kv-prefill coverage and add to postmortem if we see repeats.
alex.k: action items: 1) followup ticket for prefill coverage (maria), 2) add dynamic config rollback docs (jon), 3) monitor for 30m then mark release green. thanks all :thumbsup:
